versions.subject: Rule: APT29 Google Update service install
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 7045
    ServiceName: 'Google Update'
condition: selection

versions.subject: APT 29 - tor / google update service
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 7045
    ServiceName: 'Google Update'
selection2:
    EventID: 4688 
    NewProcessName: 
        - 'C:\Program Files(x86)\Google\GoogleService.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files(x86)\Google\GoogleUpdate.exe'
condition: selection1 or selection2
versions.spl: (EventID=7045 ServiceName="Google Update") OR (EventID=4688 NewProcessName IN ("C:\\Program Files(x86)\\Google\\GoogleService.exe", "C:\\Program Files(x86)\\Google\\GoogleUpdate.exe"))
